ACT III OF 2018
ACT III OF 2018
PROVINCIAL MOTOR VEHICLES
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2018
An Act further to amend the Provincial Motor
Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
15th February, 2018]
No. PAP/Legis-2(176)/2017/1711, dated 15.2.2018.---The
Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Bill 2017, having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on February 07, 2018, and assented to by the
Governor of the Punjab on February 15, 2018, is hereby published as an Act of
the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
It is necessary further to amend the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance,
1965 (XIX of 1965) prescribing penalty to be imposed for the non-display on a
motor vehicle the security featured number plate or, as the case may be, the
vanity plate provided to the owner by the prescribed authority or registering
authority.
Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as
follows:-
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be cited as the Provincial Motor
Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2018.
(2) It shall come
into force at once.

Insertion of new sections 82-A and 82-B in the West Pakistan Ordinance No. XIX of 1965

ACT XXXVIII OF 2018
ACT XXXVIII OF 2018
PROVINCIAL MOTOR VEHICLES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2018
An Act to amend the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV, 29th May, 2018]
NO.PAS/LEGIS-B-28/2018,
dated 29.5.2018.---The Provincial
Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Bill, 2018 having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of Sindh on 9th May, 2018 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on
25th May, 2018 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Provincial
Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:-
3. Insertion
of new sections 82-A and 82-B in the West Pakistan Ordinance No. XIX of 1965.---In the said Ordinance, after section 82, the
following new sections shall be inserted:-.
"82-A.
Duty to make way for emergency vehicle.---(1) A driver of a vehicle or any other person, to the extent
practicable, shall slow down, move to the left, or otherwise make all possible
efforts to give clear uninterrupted and safe passage to an emergency rescue
vehicle or an ambulance with active warning lights and sirens.
(2)
The driver of the vehicle giving way as in sub section (1) is not liable for an
offence under this Act and other road traffic rules as long as his actions are
necessary, reasonable and do not endanger the safety of others.
82-B.
Duty to stay clear of emergency vehicles.---A driver of a vehicle or any
other person, to the extent practicable, shall stay clear of a passing
emergency vehicle and, in particular, leave a safe distance between the
emergency vehicle and himself".

4. Insertion
of new section 87-A in the West Pakistan Ordinance No. XIX of 1965.---In the said Ordinance, after section 87, the
following new section shall be inserted:-.
"87-A.
Obstruction of emergency vehicles.---No person driving a motor vehicle, or
any other person, shall impede the progress of an emergency vehicle, with their
vehicle or otherwise.".

Substitution of new section 101-A in the West Pakistan Ordinance No. XIX of 1965

ACT XXXVIII OF 2018
ACT XXXVIII OF 2018
PROVINCIAL MOTOR VEHICLES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2018
An Act to amend the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV, 29th May, 2018]
NO.PAS/LEGIS-B-28/2018,
dated 29.5.2018.---The Provincial
Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Bill, 2018 having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of Sindh on 9th May, 2018 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on
25th May, 2018 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Provincial
Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:-
7. Substitution
of new section 101-A in the West Pakistan Ordinance No. XIX of 1965.---In the said Ordinance, for section 101-A, the
following new section shall be substituted:-
"101-A.
Use of mobile telephones.---(1) A person shall not drive a motor vehicle if
he is using a hand-held mobile telephone or a device which performs an
interactive communication function of transmitting and receiving data.
(2)
A person shall not be guilty of contravention of subsection (1) if, at the time
of the alleged contravention, he is -
(a) using
the mobile telephone or the device to call the police, fire brigade, ambulance
or other emergency service; or
(b) responding
to or acting in response to an emergency.".
